facts.fact: Adwave commissioned a national survey of 500 U.S. consumers, split evenly across four generations, on CTV viewing and mobile bookmarking.
facts.quote: A national survey of 500 U.S. consumers, split evenly across four generations, found that this habit

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 80% of viewers use a phone, tablet, or laptop while watching streaming TV at least sometimes.
facts.quote: 80% of viewers use a phone, tablet, or laptop while watching streaming TV at least

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 11.5% of respondents said they never use a second screen while watching streaming TV.
facts.quote: Only 11.5% of respondents said they never use a second screen while watching streaming TV.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, second-screen use always or most of the time is 66% for Gen Z, 63% for Millennials, 43% for Gen X, and 32% for Boomers.
facts.quote: Gen Z and Millennial viewers use a second screen "always" or "most of the time" at 66% and 63%.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, texting or messaging (70%) and scrolling social media (69%) are the most common second-screen activities.
facts.quote: Texting or messaging (70%) and scrolling social media (69%) lead the list

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 14% of respondents watch CTV while using two other devices always or most of the time.
facts.quote: 14% of respondents watch CTV while using two other devices "always" or "most of the time,"

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 37% of viewers reach for their phone within 15 minutes of starting a show, and 59% do so within 30 minutes.
facts.quote: 37% of viewers reach for their phone within 15 minutes of starting a show, and 59% do so within 30 minutes.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 71.5% of respondents have opened a browser tab or saved something on their phone while watching CTV to revisit later.
facts.quote: 71.5% of respondents have opened a browser tab or saved something on their phone while watching CTV

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 30.5% of respondents do mobile bookmarking regularly, and another 41% have done it multiple times.
facts.quote: 30.5% say they do it regularly, and another 41% say they have done it multiple times.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, mobile bookmarking regularly or occasionally is 84% for Gen Z, 82% for Millennials, 70% for Gen X, and 50% for Boomers.
facts.quote: Gen Z (84%) and Millennials (82%) bookmark regularly or occasionally, compared with 70% of Gen X and 50% of Boomers.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, over the previous two months the most common saved item was a product or item to buy, at 54.75% of respondents.
facts.quote: the most common thing saved for later was a product or item to buy (54.75% of respondents)

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 40.75% of respondents saved a show, film, or song to check out, and 37.25% saved a restaurant or local business to visit.
facts.quote: Next came a show, film, or song to check out (40.75%), a restaurant or local business to visit (37.25%)

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 29.5% of respondents saved a brand or company to research for later.
facts.quote: and a brand or company to research (29.5%).

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 52% of Gen Z respondents have bookmarked a local business or restaurant, compared with 39% of Millennials, 35% of Gen X, and 23% of Boomers.
facts.quote: 52% of Gen Z respondents have bookmarked a local business or restaurant, compared with 39% of Millennials, 35% of Gen X, and 23% of Boomers.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, nearly 58% of all respondents have searched for a business or product after seeing it on CTV.
facts.quote: Nearly 58% of all respondents have searched for a business or product after seeing it on CTV.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, post-ad search is reported by 69% of Gen Z and Millennial viewers, 60% of Gen X, and 33% of Boomers.
facts.quote: That rises to 69% of Gen Z and Millennial viewers, compared with 60% of Gen X and 33% of Boomers.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 39.5% of respondents' last post-ad search was for a smaller or local business they were not familiar with, versus 30.75% for a well-known national brand.
facts.quote: more respondents named a smaller or local business they were not familiar with (39.5%) than a well-known national brand (30.75%).

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, the top reason for searching after a CTV ad was 'I hadn't heard of the brand before and wanted to know more' at 42.5%.
facts.quote: The top reason for searching after a CTV ad was "I hadn't heard of the brand before and wanted to know more" (42.5%).

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, 40.5% of respondents searched to check reviews before considering a purchase after seeing a CTV ad.
facts.quote: checking reviews before considering a purchase (40.5%)

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, recognizing a familiar brand and wanting to buy right away was the least common search reason, at 12.5%.
facts.quote: Recognizing a familiar brand and wanting to buy right away was the least common reason, at 12.5%.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's survey, Gen Z's last post-ad search was for a national brand at 48% and a local business at 33%, the only generation leaning national.
facts.quote: Gen Z is the exception, at 48% national vs. 33% local.

facts.fact: Adwave runs paid media on Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV from one prepaid daily budget starting at $30/day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that Reddit and Google Search typically need a higher daily budget before they switch on.
